title: Performance evidence — spoken follow-up
situation: In a technical discussion, an optimization is said to be twice as fast. You must answer aloud accurately without overstating the evidence.
instructions: Deliver a sixty-second answer with decision, evidence, limitation and one clarifying question.

vocabulary.meaning: the precise concept required for performance evidence
an observation supported by a reproducible check

expectedElements: A clear decision tied to the scenario
Verified evidence and one explicit limitation
modelAnswer: My decision is that The claim needs the same scenario, workload, environment and measurement method before and after, plus unchanged functional tests. The current evidence is limited to the documented checks, so I would not claim more. Which constraint or observation would make us revisit this decision?
commonMistakes: Using confident adjectives without naming evidence or a limitation
variants: Answer again after the reviewer changes one cost or security constraint.
